title: Grand Slam of Darts: Friday quarter-finals
why: Quarter-finals: Doets beat Wattimena 16-7 and Price edged Springer 16-15 to set up a semi-final.

title: Grand Slam of Darts: Saturday quarter-finals
why: The last two quarter-finals: Sykes v van Gerwen and van Veen v Aspinall, at 2:00 PM New York time.

title: Grand Slam of Darts: semi-finals
why: Both semi-finals, starting at 8:00 AM New York time, with Doets v Price already set.

title: Grand Slam of Darts: final
why: The Grand Slam final, starting at 2:30 PM New York time.

title: NWSL Championship: Washington Spirit v Kansas City Current
why: The Spirit and the Current meet for the NWSL title at Audi Field, 8:00 PM New York time, on CBS and Paramount+.
